snippet.title: Princess Pomu and the 5 moons release date trailer.
snippet.description:
After 5 long years of solo development, Princess Pomu and the 5 moons will finally be released on June 26th on Steam and the Nintendo Eshop! A cute pixel art metroidvania with a violent twist!

Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642520/Princess_Pomu_and_the_5_Moons/

Eshop
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/pixel-game-maker-series-princess-pomu-and-the-5-moons-switch/
